audited_plan.image_description: A close-up photograph of a bright green snake, identified as a Green Mamba, draped over thin branches. The head is raised and facing slightly right, showing vivid emerald green coloration with smooth scales. The eye is dark and distinct. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige/brown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large and dark with round pupils.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible, dark black, and appears round. While pupil detail is hard to see at this resolution, the overall morphology matches.
The visible portion of the body behind the head is slender and maintains a consistent diameter, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform green coloration with no patterning.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scales are smooth and highly glossy with a reflective surface.

The tail is not visible in the frame; the image focuses on the head and anterior body.
